The affix अच् comes after the verb अर्ह 'to respect', when the object is in composition with it.

Terms: अच्

The affix शतृ comes after the verb अर्ह in expressing praise.

Terms: शतृ

The affixes कृत्य and the affix तृच are added to a root when fitness as regards the agent is implied (as well as in the affix लिङ् (Benedictive) ).

Terms: कृत्य and तृच

, inclusive, the affix ठक् (+/- इक or +/- क)
